_source: Shaped after the provider's documented response (https://github.com/linear/linear/blob/master/packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql, Issue.comments, CommentConnection; https://linear.app/developers/graphql).

expectedBody.query: query ListIssueComments($id: String!, $after: String) { issue(id: $id) { id identifier comments(first: 20, after: $after) { nodes { id body createdAt editedAt url user { id name } parent { id } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }
